description: AGSC-06-46: every generated HTML page carries in its head a describedby link to /llms.txt with type text/plain, and every item page also an alternate link with type text/markdown to its /pages/<slug>.md — the two relations llms.txt v2 (modified 2026-08-10, llmstxt.org, read 2026-10-29) defines for a page. The minimal fixture, built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history: the home page and /clusters/ carry the describedby link only, the concept page /concepts/handoff/ carries both. The discovery document is still reached by its own describedby link, selected by its type (AGSC-06-25). Derived by hand.
